description: Phase 8 release gate record. A gate is 'verified' only with evidence that exists in this repository or a linked record; never flip from CI results alone. rolloutMode stays 'shadow' and releaseAuthorized false until every gate is verified and the owner signs off.

gates.evidence: Create Only writes are denied by default at four server layers (global guard, canonical tenant-boundary check, per-route createOnlyVerifiedCreate guard, offline sync apply handlers). All 24 Phase 1 create candidates were reviewed handler-by-handler; 13 signatures are verified with request guards and 11 kept denied with reasons in docs/permissions-control-center-phase3-route-review.md. Evidence: tests/access-control-v2-create-only-activation.test.ts (every manifest write) and tests/access-control-v2-create-only-http.test.ts (1,100+ routes over HTTP on PostgreSQL, unchanged fingerprints), both passing on branch feature/permissions-control-center-activation.
gates.required: Review and enforce every eligible business-write handler across ERP, Factory, POS and Properties; Phase 3 incomplete
All role-sensitive controls integrated and verified against existing backend guards; Phase 6 incomplete
gates.progress: Partial: shared verified-create catalog, client request guard and useExistingRecordChangeAccess on Customers, Suppliers, Stock Items, Daybook table, Properties rentals and Retail products. Remaining: remaining ERP/Factory/POS pages still show edit controls to Create Only (the request guard and server refuse them with a readable message); per-page parity review not done.

gates.required: Staging backup validated and additive shadow migration applied with RLS checks
gates.progress: Isolated validation done: npm run verify:permissions-shadow-migration passes on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 cluster (atomic failure, idempotent re-run, FORCE RLS isolation for a non-superuser owner, override and append-only audit triggers, business data unchanged). Blocker: no staging database, verified backup or production service role is available to this change.

gates.required: Compare staging voucher/stock/container/payroll before-after snapshots and confirm zero unexpected differences
gates.progress: Local evidence only: the HTTP suite and migration validation show unchanged business-table fingerprints. Blocker: staging before/after comparison of vouchers, ledger balances, stock/kg/cost, containers and payroll not performed.

gates.required: Cross-company and direct API tests pass across roles, locations and resource lifecycle states
gates.progress: Partial: Create Only direct-API, cross-company body and stale-session refusals pass over HTTP; legacy roles are unaffected by the Create Only guard across every manifest write. Remaining: location-scoped and resource-lifecycle matrix across all roles on staging.

gates.required: Admin-led rollback simulation confirmed with audit history preserved and access restored
gates.progress: Procedure documented in docs/permissions-control-center-activation.md; migration atomicity verified locally. Blocker: drill must be performed and recorded on staging by an administrator.

gates.required: All required CI, UI, security, translations, TypeScript, lint and browser suites green on final SHA
gates.progress: Pending: required CI must be green on the final release SHA.

gates.required: Admin instructions reviewed, support ownership named, deny-rate alerts verified, post-release monitoring assigned
gates.progress: Admin guide, activation runbook and monitoring signals are written. Blocker: support owner, escalation path and alert verification must be named and confirmed by the business.

gates.required: Separate explicit production merge, activation and deployment approval
gates.progress: Pending explicit owner approval for merge, staging migration and each activation step.
